meta.title: Channel API keys
meta.description: Adds a key button to the conversation header, just left of the Session's More menu. It edits the ordered key pool of the model channel behind the current model selection: the card lists every key with a masked preview and whether it is in use or was rejected, accepts one key or a whole pasted block, and lets you reorder, restore, or delete entries. When a request is rejected as an invalid API key (DSH's AUTH class), the Host marks that key and hands the next request to the next key in order, so a channel with several keys keeps working; when every key has failed once the sweep restarts. Keys live in this profile's credential store through the same Host API the Models settings page uses, one reference per slot, and never enter the transcript or the pool document. Channels that sign in with a DeepSeek account have no editable key. Turning the plugin off removes the button; stored keys stay.
